items.title: Add C# SDK naming customizations
items.summary: Adds C#-specific client names for the managed maintenance-window POST operation and its request model. The change affects generated C# naming only; it does not alter the ARM wire contract or establish a language-neutral SDK surface change.

inferenceResults.rationale: The added @@clientName statements only customize C# generated names. They do not change serialized requests or responses, and the bounded evidence does not establish a language-neutral downstream SDK contract change.

items.title: Retarget the C# management emitter to an existing preview API
items.summary: Changes the C# management emitter selection from API version 2026-02-01 to the already-defined 2026-05-01-preview version. This changes generation input selection, not the service's TypeSpec API declarations or REST contract.

inferenceResults.rationale: Changing an emitter's selected existing API version does not itself alter the REST contract or a language-neutral SDK declaration. No contract candidate is supported by the supplied hunk.
